verdict.rationale: Evidence pack has no documentation of CPU core/thread counts, boost clock behavior, or independent multi-core/compile benchmarks; all first-party docs focus on AI/NPU/LLM inference tooling, and community links discuss GPU/AI token throughput rather than developer compile workloads. One HN comment even criticizes CPU-only benchmarking of this chip as 'terrible' and beside the point, underscoring the absence of credible CPU compute corroboration. missing for 10: documented core/thread counts, boost clock specs, and independent multi-core or code-compilation benchmark results.
